name: Cbl proto-oncogene
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: CBL encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase CBL. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to CBL-related disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia; Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
